h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nadiad

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Nadiad

items.pText: Nadiad, the Kheda district town where Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel was born, sits on the main road and rail route between Ahmedabad and Vadodara. That route also links it to our factory in Vasai, about 370 km to the south, so equipment reaches Nadiad by road without much difficulty. Schools, housing societies and temple trusts in the town and around Anand make up most of our enquiries from this part of central Gujarat.

Once the equipment is made, most of the work on site is the installation. Many pieces are grouted into concrete, and the ground needs to be ready before our team or a dealer arrives. This page explains what that preparation involves. Send us your site size, the age group of the children and a few photos. We will tell you which method suits your ground and mark the safe play area on a layout drawing.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Grouting means fixing the legs of the equipment into concrete pits dug in the ground. Before installation day, clear the area of debris and level it as far as possible. Tell us if there are buried pipes, cables or old foundations, because pits cannot go over them.

Fresh concrete needs time to set before children use the equipment, so plan the opening after that and keep the area closed off until then. items.q: What do we need to prepare before installation in Nadiad?
items.a: A cleared and roughly level area, access for the installation team, and information on any buried pipes or cables. If the equipment is grouted, keep the area closed until the concrete has set.
No. Some sites suit a self-standing installation, especially on firm paved ground. We choose the method after seeing photos of your site and checking the equipment you have selected.

items.q: Do you supply Anand and the rest of Kheda district?
items.a: Yes. We dispatch by road from Vasai to towns across central Gujarat, and our team or a local dealer installs the equipment. The process is the same as for Nadiad.
